  ?place wdt:[property:located in the administrative territorial entity] wd:[entity:Oxford] .
  ?place wdt:[property:coordinate location] ?coord .
  ?place wdt:[property:instance of] ?type .
  BIND(
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:university], "0000FF",
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:museum], "FF0000",
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:church building], "00FF00",
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:library], "FFFF00",
    IF(?type = wd:[entity:park], "FF00FF",
    "808080"))))) AS ?rgb
  )
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". }
}

  ?place wdt:P131 wd:Q34217 .
